title: Red Cross steps up response as nearly 586K affected by habagat, cyclones
desc: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Red Cross (PRC) has stepped up its humanitarian response as nearly 586,000 people have been affected by the combined effects of the enhanced southwest monsoon or “Habagat” and Tropical Cyclones Luis and Maymay, citing figures from the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC).

title: New findings do not support the use of edoxaban in AF patients after intracranial hemorrhage
desc: Edoxaban did not reduce stroke or systemic embolism but increased major bleeding in high-risk patients with atrial fibrillation who had had an intracranial hemorrhage, according to results presented in a Hot Line session today at ESC Congress 2026.
